sources.text: Mark Tuszynski Lab Center for Neural Repair Our research aims to identify potential treatments for currently untreatable neurological disorders, including Alzheimer’s Disease and Spinal Cord Injury. Our Research Current Projects Spinal Cord Injury Our research focuses on augmenting regeneration of the adult spinal cord after injury. Discover More Alzheimer's Disease We study degenerative changes in the brain of both normal aging and pathological disorders such as Alzheimer’s disease. Explore more Neural Plasticity We explore the innate ability of the adult brain to undergo structural and functional adaptation as a result of experience. Find out more BDNF Gene Therapy Trial Our group is sponsoring a first-in-human clinical trial of gene therapy in Alzheimer’s Disease and Mild Cognitive Impairment. This trial has been approved by the FDA and the UC San Diego Human Subjects Safety Committee. About the trial Our Team Meet Us Our Publications Read more Support Our Work Your gift will directly benefit our quest to find therapies for today’s untreatable neurological injuries and disorders. How to donate Contact us Mark Tuszynski, M.D., Ph.D. Director, UC San Diego Translational Neuroscience Institute Email: mtuszynski@ucsd.edu
